info.title: agentspace — AgentSpace
info.description: Agent workspace launcher with a per-workspace SSH file tree, transparent in-app code preview (AvaloniaEdit + TextMate grammars), and SQLite-persisted session/connection history. Each workspace pairs an agent CLI terminal (claude/codex/aider — configurable) with a free shell tab. Distributed as a .NET global tool. Built on AgentSpace.Avalonia.XTerm.
